meta.sourcePolicy: Definitions are authoritative for signatures, parameter names and categories; sources.overlays lists lsl.dev-local category additions. Wiki text remains a historical community source; templates are partially rendered; source.sources lists every wiki page and template each page was built from, with its revision.

overlays.note: lsl.dev-local category overlay, not upstream data; adds category membership on top of the definitions

definitionsHistory.note: added/updated on functions, events and constants are dates (YYYY-MM-DD) from lsl-definitions git history; added = null means the item existed at the baseline import; updated counts behaviour changes only

functions.name: llAddToLandBanList
functions.description: Adds the avatar to the parcel ban list for the specified number of hours. A value of 0 hours adds the avatar indefinitely. Banned users teleporting to the parcel are redirected to a neighboring parcel; the minimum accepted duration is 0.01 hours (approximately 36 seconds).

parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to add to the ban list.

parameters.description: Duration, in hours, to ban the avatar for (0 for indefinite).

hours.tooltip: Duration, in hours, to ban the avatar for (0 for indefinite).

definition.tooltip: Adds the avatar to the parcel ban list for the specified number of hours. A value of 0 hours adds the avatar indefinitely. Banned users teleporting to the parcel are redirected to a neighboring parcel; the minimum accepted duration is 0.01 hours (approximately 36 seconds).

parameters.description: Starting location vector of the ray.

parameters.name: end_pos
parameters.description: Ending location vector of the ray.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of option flags and their parameters to configure the raycast.

start_pos.tooltip: Starting location vector of the ray.

end_pos.tooltip: Ending location vector of the ray.

options.tooltip: A list of option flags and their parameters to configure the raycast.

definition.tooltip: Casts a ray into the physics world from start to end and reports collision data for intersections with objects based on options. Returns a list of strided values [UUID_1, {link_number_1}, hit_position_1, {hit_normal_1}, ..., status_code]. A negative status_code indicates an error; otherwise, it represents the number of hits.

definition.tooltip: Sets the collision filter, either exclusively or inclusively. If accept is TRUE, only collisions matching name and id are processed; if FALSE, matches are excluded. Pass an empty string or NULL_KEY to name or id to skip filtering on that parameter.

parameters.description: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llTransfer* function.

parameters.description: Boolean. TRUE if the L$ transfer succeeded, FALSE otherwise.

constants.name: CHANGED_MEDIA

definition.tooltip: Object has changed owners. Triggers in the original object when a user takes it, copies it, or deeds it to a group, and in the new object when it is first rezzed.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents attachments worn by passengers from pushing the vehicle via llPushObject or other scripting functions.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_CAMERA_DECOUPLED
constants.description: Vehicle flag used with mouselook steering/banking. When set, the passenger's mouselook camera rotates independently of the vehicle's orientation.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag used with mouselook steering/banking. When set, the passenger's mouselook camera rotates independently of the vehicle's orientation.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_GLOBAL_HEIGHT
constants.description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to maintain a global height rather than hovering relative to the ground or water.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to maintain a global height rather than hovering relative to the ground or water.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_TERRAIN_ONLY
constants.description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore water height and hover exclusively relative to the terrain/land.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore water height and hover exclusively relative to the terrain/land.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_UP_ONLY
constants.description: Vehicle flag preventing hover from pushing downward, allowing hovering vehicles to jump or fly above their designated hover height.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag preventing hover from pushing downward, allowing hovering vehicles to jump or fly above their designated hover height.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_WATER_ONLY
constants.description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore terrain height and hover exclusively relative to water.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore terrain height and hover exclusively relative to water.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_MOTOR_UP
constants.description: Vehicle flag that prevents ground vehicles from motoring upward into the sky. When combined with banking, banking strength decays when the vehicle is airborne (no longer colliding) to prevent steering mid-jump.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents ground vehicles from motoring upward into the sky. When combined with banking, banking strength decays when the vehicle is airborne (no longer colliding) to prevent steering mid-jump.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_ROLL_ONLY
constants.description: Vehicle flag for vehicles with a vertical attractor that need to climb or dive, allowing airplanes to use the banking feature.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag for vehicles with a vertical attractor that need to climb or dive, allowing airplanes to use the banking feature.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_BANK
constants.description: Vehicle flag that enables mouselook control, remapping left-right camera motions (yaw) to rotations about the vehicle's local X-axis.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that enables mouselook control, remapping left-right camera motions (yaw) to rotations about the vehicle's local X-axis.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_STEER
constants.description: Vehicle flag that enables steering via mouse, directing the angular motor to align the vehicle's local X-axis with the direction of the client-side camera.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that enables steering via mouse, directing the angular motor to align the vehicle's local X-axis with the direction of the client-side camera.

constants.name: VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP
constants.description: Vehicle flag that prevents linear deflection parallel to the world Z-axis, preventing ground vehicles (such as bumper cars) from climbing into the sky.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents linear deflection parallel to the world Z-axis, preventing ground vehicles (such as bumper cars) from climbing into the sky.

constants.name: VEHICLE_HOVER_EFFICIENCY
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling hover damping, where 0.0 is bouncy and 1.0 is critically damped.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling hover damping, where 0.0 is bouncy and 1.0 is critically damped.

constants.name: VEHICLE_HOVER_HEIGHT
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the height at which the vehicle attempts to hover. Set to 0.0 to disable hover.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the height at which the vehicle attempts to hover. Set to 0.0 to disable hover.

constants.name: VEHICLE_HOVER_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the timescale (period of time in seconds) for the vehicle to achieve its hover height.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the timescale (period of time in seconds) for the vehicle to achieve its hover height.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) modulating the efficiency and strength of linear deflection. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of linear deflection.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) modulating the efficiency and strength of linear deflection. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of linear deflection.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to redirect its linear velocity along its preferred X-axis. It is another way to specify how much time it takes for the vehicle's linear velocity to be redirected to its preferred axis of motion.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to redirect its linear velocity along its preferred X-axis. It is another way to specify how much time it takes for the vehicle's linear velocity to be redirected to its preferred axis of motion.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of linear velocity along the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

definition.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of linear velocity along the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the linear motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the linear motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION
constants.description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the linear velocity (range [0, 30] m/s) that the vehicle's linear motor attempts to achieve.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the linear velocity (range [0, 30] m/s) that the vehicle's linear motor attempts to achieve.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_OFFSET
constants.description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the offset from the vehicle's center of mass where the linear motor force is applied.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the offset from the vehicle's center of mass where the linear motor force is applied.

constants.name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to reach its full linear motor velocity.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to reach its full linear motor velocity.

constants.name: VEHICLE_REFERENCE_FRAME
constants.description: Vehicle rotation parameter setting the orientation of the vehicle's preferred axes of motion (at, left, up) relative to its local geometric frame (x, y, z).

definition.tooltip: Vehicle rotation parameter setting the orientation of the vehicle's preferred axes of motion (at, left, up) relative to its local geometric frame (x, y, z).

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_AIRPLANE

definition.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for aircraft that use linear deflection for lift, banking to turn, and no hover.

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BALLOON

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BOAT

definition.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for boats that hover over water with high friction and minor angular deflection.

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_CAR

definition.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for land vehicles that bounce along the ground and rely on external controls or timer events to drive their motors.

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_NONE
constants.description: Constant used to disable and turn off vehicle physics support on the object.

definition.tooltip: Constant used to disable and turn off vehicle physics support on the object.

constants.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_SLED
constants.description: Vehicle type constant for sliding vehicles that bump along the ground and prefer to move along their local X-axis.

definition.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for sliding vehicles that bump along the ground and prefer to move along their local X-axis.

constants.name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_EFFICIENCY
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling vertical attraction stability (0.0 is wobbly/bouncy, 1.0 is critically damped/firm) to keep the vehicle upright.

constants.name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_TIMESCALE
constants.description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the vehicle to rotate and align its local Z-axis (up) with the world Z-axis (vertical).

definition.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the vehicle to rotate and align its local Z-axis (up) with the world Z-axis (vertical).

types.name: float
types.description:
32 bit floating point value.
The range is 1.175494351E-38 to 3.402823466E+38.

definition.tooltip: 32 bit floating point value.\nThe range is 1.175494351E-38 to 3.402823466E+38.

types.name: integer
types.description:
32 bit integer value.
−2,147,483,648 and +2,147,483,647 (that is 0x80000000 to 0x7FFFFFFF in hex).

definition.tooltip: 32 bit integer value.\n−2,147,483,648 and +2,147,483,647 (that is 0x80000000 to 0x7FFFFFFF in hex).

types.name: key
types.description:
A 128 bit unique identifier (UUID).
The key is represented as hexidecimal characters (A-F and 0-9), grouped into sections (8,4,4,4,12 characters) and separated by hyphens (for a total of 36 characters). e.g. "A822FF2B-FF02-461D-B45D-DCD10A2DE0C2".

definition.tooltip: A 128 bit unique identifier (UUID).\nThe key is represented as hexidecimal characters (A-F and 0-9), grouped into sections (8,4,4,4,12 characters) and separated by hyphens (for a total of 36 characters). e.g. "A822FF2B-FF02-461D-B45D-DCD10A2DE0C2".

types.name: list
types.description:
A collection of other data types.
Lists are signified by square brackets surrounding their elements; the elements inside are separated by commas. e.g. [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] or ["Yes", "No", "Perhaps"].

definition.tooltip: A collection of other data types.\nLists are signified by square brackets surrounding their elements; the elements inside are separated by commas. e.g. [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] or ["Yes", "No", "Perhaps"].

types.name: rotation
types.description:
Rotation type is one of several ways to represent an orientation in 3D.
It is a mathematical object called a quaternion. You can think of a quaternion as four numbers (x, y, z, w), three of which represent the direction an object is facing and a fourth that represents the object's banking left or right around that direction.

definition.tooltip: Rotation type is one of several ways to represent an orientation in 3D.\nIt is a mathematical object called a quaternion. You can think of a quaternion as four numbers (x, y, z, w), three of which represent the direction an object is facing and a fourth that represents the object's banking left or right around that direction.

types.name: string
types.description:
Text data.
The editor accepts UTF-8 encoded text.

definition.tooltip: Text data.\nThe editor accepts UTF-8 encoded text.

types.name: vector
types.description:
A vector is a data type that contains a set of three float values.
Vectors are used to represent colors (RGB), positions, and directions/velocities.

definition.tooltip: A vector is a data type that contains a set of three float values.\nVectors are used to represent colors (RGB), positions, and directions/velocities.

If another state is defined before the default state, the compiler will report a syntax error.
